visual_brief.subject: Claude Code 2.1.289 fixes additional deny-rule and symlink gaps
verified_context: Claude Code 2.1.289 was published at 23:07:17 UTC on October 3, which is 01:07:17 on October 4 in Luxembourg.
Its release notes describe additional fixes involving managed deny rules, IDE symlink reads and environment-prefixed Bash commands.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Upgrade and test policy precedence, symlinked IDE paths and environment-prefixed commands against real managed rules.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Several solid charcoal architectural passageways converge at a single heavy terracotta gate seated firmly across the opening. A short curved side passage also meets that same gate. This is an abstract policy-boundary metaphor, never a claim of complete protection.
must_show: centered focal elements that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Viable alternate. The gate and converging paths convey policy, with more landscape detail than needed.
candidate_notes.B: Viable alternate. The curved secondary path is strong, but the oblique gate reads less immediately at thumbnail size.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. A centered terracotta gate and converging stone passages produce the clearest crop-safe boundary metaphor. It is an abstract editorial image, not evidence that all bypasses are closed.

The gate is more literal and the cutaway less diagrammatic; Golden Reference Fit is 88. Without headline or company name it remains in the publication's visual family.
